eval: const values=await chrome.storage.local.get('theme'); const session=await chrome.storage.session.get('draft'); if(values.theme!=='primary'||session.draft!=='primary'||localStorage.getItem('isolatedProfile')!==null) throw new Error('Profile isolation or shared storage failed'); localStorage.setItem('isolatedProfile','peer'); await chrome.storage.local.set({theme:'peer'}); await chrome.storage.session.set({draft:'peer'}); return true;

await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,300)); const values=await chrome.storage.local.get('theme'); const session=await chrome.storage.session.get('draft'); if(values.theme!=='peer'||session.draft!=='peer'||localStorage.getItem('isolatedProfile')!=='primary'||!sharedChanges.some(event=>event.area==='local'&&event.changes.theme?.newValue==='peer')) throw new Error('Cross-profile change delivery failed'); return true;
